source.name: Chapter 6: 1.3 Test Your Knowledge - task_completed tool
source.instructions: In a general-purpose sub-agent in Rasa, how does the sub-agent tell the main agent it has finished?

answers.answer: It calls the built-in `task_completed` tool, which exits the reasoning loop and returns control to the main flow
It sends a status code back through `endpoints.yml`
The main flow sets a timeout and automatically resumes after 30 seconds
It deletes its slot data, which the main agent detects as a completion signal

source.learningObjectives: SWBAT exit criteria for general sub-agents
source.guidance: `task_completed` is the sub-agent's explicit signal that the task is done. The LLM calls it like any other tool. The loop exits and the main flow resumes at the next step after `call:`.
